Apollo, ZoomInfo, and similar platforms are built on contact-centric databases curated largely from North American and European corporate sources. The “Director” or “Owner” you need might be the person who answers the phone at the trading company in Deira. Static databases rarely index these individuals, and when they do, the email is often the generic info@ address.
